verdict.rationale: The evidence shows agent-originated payments are tokenized and processed through Adyen, and that the integration works with existing order management systems. Nothing in the pack covers settlement, payouts, reporting or reconciliation for agentic transactions. Generic webhooks and order-management compatibility are adjacent features, not documented settlement or reconciliation flows for this channel.

support.subject: As a merchant, agent-originated payments settle through documented payout and reporting flows, reconcilable like any other channel
